sentences.text: The weather will change quickly, so we will check the news every morning, and we are not pessimistic about it.
sentences.translation: 天气会变化得很快,所以我们每天早上都会查看新闻,我们对此并不悲观。

grammar.note: be pessimistic about 表示"对……持悲观态度"。
